description: Convert an image to PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP or ICO from freedailypro, with optional quality, background colour, resize (fit modes), rotate/flip, grayscale, DPI and metadata controls. Inputs: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF (animated kept for GIF/WebP output), AVIF, TIFF, SVG, BMP. HEIC is not supported. Returns the converted file as base64 text.

animated.description: Keep every frame of an animated GIF/WebP when the output is GIF or WebP. Default true

autoOrient.description: Turn photos upright from their EXIF rotation flag. Default true

backgroundColor.description: Fill for transparent areas, e.g. '#ffffff', 'ffffff' or 'white'. Default white for JPEG and 24-bit BMP; for other formats only applied when given

dpi.description: Print resolution written into PNG, JPEG, TIFF and BMP

effort.description: 0 fastest to 10 smallest file (clamped to what the format allows; 'speed' is the same thing)

fit.description: How the picture meets width and height. Default inside

format.description: png, jpeg (or jpg), webp, avif, gif, tiff, bmp or ico; image/... types such as image/webp also work

grayscale.description: Whether to convert the image to grayscale.

lossless.description: WebP/AVIF lossless; false on PNG makes a smaller 256-colour palette PNG

pngCompressionLevel.description: The PNG compression level (0-9). Between 0 and 9.

pngPalette.description: PNG: reduce to a 256-colour palette for a smaller file

quality.description: 0-1 (for example 0.8) or 1-100 (for example 80); JPEG, WebP, AVIF (and TIFF with jpeg compression, palette PNG)

rotate.description: Multiple of 90 degrees clockwise (not for animated images)

stripMetadata.description: Remove EXIF/ICC data. Default true; false keeps it

tiffCompression.description: The TIFF compression to use. One of: none, lzw, deflate, jpeg.

withoutEnlargement.description: Never make the picture bigger than the original

name: image_convert
